lcc_original: 該隱對永恆主說；『我的罪罰太重，過於我所能擔當的。
notes: 耶和華 (H03068) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton; SN attaches to full phrase 永恆主
刑罰 (H05771) → 罪罰: LCC uses 罪罰 to render עָוֹן, which preserves the iniquity/guilt-punishment semantic range; straightforward attachment
當 (H05375) → 擔當: LCC expands UNV's abbreviated 當 to the full compound 擔當 (bear/carry); both render נָשָׂא, so all three SNs attach to 擔當的
